proofs.race_free:
by
  have hp : program = LarkMFMA.Tile.program := by decide
  obtain ⟨final, hr, hrf, hout⟩ := (LarkMFMA.Tile.correct unitOps) (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())
  refine ⟨final, ?_, hrf⟩
  simpa only [hp] using hr
proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  rewrite [segmentation_data]
  have hp : program = LarkMFMA.Tile.program := by decide
  have hs : spec ops = LarkMFMA.Tile.spec ops := by rfl
  rewrite [hp, hs]
  exact LarkMFMA.Tile.correct ops
